notes: Jewellery VAT 5% on full value; investment precious metals (99%+, tradeable form) zero-rated. Premiums: Gold Trade (Dubai dealer) asks read 28 Nov 2026 vs Dubai board reference 439.00 AED/g 24K (Al Romaizan): 10g 4,622.13 (+5.3%), 20g 9,169.50 (+4.4%), 50g 22,819.95 (+4.0%), 10 tola 52,700.97 (+2.9%). Making % dropped: no dealer's own page states one.

sources.name: UAE Ministry of Finance - Executive Regulation of Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017 (Cabinet Decision No. 52 of 2017), Article 36
sources.what: Article 36: 'The supply or import of investment precious metals shall be zero-rated', where investment precious metals means gold, silver and platinum of a purity of 99 percent or more in a form tradeable in global bullion markets - gold and silver bullion VAT 0%.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - United Arab Emirates, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: 'The general VAT rate is 5% and applies to most goods and services' - retail gold and silver jewellery, which does not meet the investment-metal test, is taxed at 5% on the full value including making charges.

sources.name: Al Romaizan - Gold Rate in UAE Today
sources.what: Dealer's published Dubai reference rates, updated 28 Nov 2026 00:00 GST: 24K gold 439.00 AED per gram (gold value only, excluding making charges and VAT), 22K 406.50, 21K 389.75, 18K 334.00 - the 24K rate is the reference base used for the premium calculations.

sources.name: Gold Trade - Gold Bars and Coins store
